Name: CoD army dog Riley
Author: DraGonNuGGet
Description:
可选更新：

增加了适配尾号为24026的mod的手动更换的贴图包
Add a optional manual texture pack for mod pets enhanced (Nexus 24026)

1.0.1更新：

优化了3号狗勾（全副武装的莱利）的贴图
Improve Dog2(fully armed Riley)'s texture

========================

1号狗勾：只戴着狗牌的莱利（短暂出现在航母关卡）
Dog: Riley only wearing collar

2号狗勾：穿着部分装备的莱利（出现在重返老家等关卡）
Dog1: Riley wearing some gear

3号狗勾：全副武装的莱利（出现在寻找Ajax等关卡）
Dog2: Fully armed Riley


要求：下载SMAPI和Content Patcher
Requirement: SMAPI & Content Patcher

使用：下载并解压，然后放到C:\steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods（或者你的自定义steam文件路径）里
How to install this mod: Download file, extract file, then put file in C:\steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods (or your custom steam files)

有问题欢迎联系我！❤
Feel free to contact me! ❤

========================

额外推荐：使用mod “Pets Enhanced - A Pet Mechanic Overhaul (Dropped)” （尾号24026）或者mod“The Stardew Squad” （尾号35341）可以和莱利并肩战斗哦！
Extra: use mod "Pets Enhanced - A Pet Mechanic Overhaul (Dropped)" or mod "The Stardew Squad" which allow you to fight with Riley!
